rubric.qualified: both locked reviewers return true on all five axes and distinct against every archive
rubric.uncertainty_eligible: neither reviewer returns false on any axis or equivalent against any archive; structural validity and available indispensable resources remain required
rubric.upper: maximum clique of distinct-or-unknown edges among uncertainty-eligible cards
